GoCluster help - CC dialect

Getting started:
  SHOW/DX 10             Show 10 recent spots matching your filters.
  SHOW/FILTER            Inspect active native CC selections.
  SHOW SETTINGS          Inspect preferences and session settings.
  SET GRID FN31          Set your grid square.
  BYE                    Disconnect.

Type HELP followed by a command for details:
  HELP SET/FILTER
  HELP SET/NOFILTER
  HELP FILTERS

Reading and posting spots:
  SHOW/DX | SH/DX        Search recent spots matching your filters.
  SHOW MYDX              Same history with explicit query selections.
  DX                     Post a spot.
  SHOW DXCC              Look up callsign or country metadata.
  WHOSPOTSME             Show recent spotter countries for your call.

Space weather bulletins:
  SHOW WWV [FULL]        Show WWV bulletins; FULL selects retained history.
  SHOW WCY [FULL]        Show WCY bulletins; FULL selects retained history.

Examples:
  SHOW/DX 10 BAND 20     Search for 10 matching spots on 20m.
  SHOW/DX 10 MODE CW     Search for 10 matching CW spots.
  SHOW/DX 10 COMMENT CQ  Search stored comments for literal CQ.
  DX 14025.0 K1ABC CQ    Post a DX spot.

Changing filters:
  SET/FILTER             Replace geography or edit frequency slots.
  SET/<MODE>             Enable an operator-configured mode shortcut.
  SET/NO<MODE>           Disable an operator-configured mode shortcut.
  UNSET/<MODE>           Disable the same configured mode.
  SET/SKIMMER            Enable the SKIMMER source selection.
  SET/NOSKIMMER          Disable the SKIMMER source selection.
  UNSET/SKIMMER          Disable the SKIMMER source selection.
  SET/NOFILTER           Restore operator defaults; keep switches.
  SHOW/FILTER FULL       Show native selections, controls and DXBM basis.
  SH/FILTER              Short form of SHOW/FILTER.

What you can filter:
  DOC/DOS select spotter country/state; DXCTY/DXSTATE select the DX.
  Mode and source selections both apply. Geography categories use AND.
  Values within one list use OR. Missing data fails PASS and survives REJECT.
  OFF disables only its category. DXBM selects frequency, not decoded mode.

A complete recipe:
  SET/NOFILTER
  SET/FILTER DOC/PASS K,VE
  SET/FILTER DXBM/PASS 20-CW,40
  SHOW/FILTER

Filter rules to remember:
  Geography edits replace their list and clear that category's band
  exceptions.
  DXBM edits are incremental; first PASS after OFF starts a whitelist.
  First REJECT starts a blacklist. Active allow-all remains active.
  Mode shortcuts require the operator's cc_shortcut flag.
  Per-band geography uses native schema-seven YAML; terminal syntax and
  CC User integration for per-band geography remain unverified.
  Long lists need YAML; splitting replacing commands loses earlier values.
  Boolean mutations require DIALECT GO, which preserves the CC bank.

Comment rules:
  SHOW/DX COMMENT is a history search, not a saved CC category.

Separate switches:
  PASS | REJECT             Enable or disable the six separate switches.
  UNSET/FILTER              Disable a named switch; see HELP.
  SET/ANN | SET/NOANN       Allow or block announcements.
  SET/BEACON | SET/NOBEACON Allow or block beacon spots.
  SET/WWV | SET/NOWWV       Allow or block WWV bulletins.
  SET/WCY | SET/NOWCY       Allow or block WCY bulletins.
  SET/SELF | SET/NOSELF     Allow or block spots of your own call.
  TOXIC is a GoCluster switch for already classified toxic spots.
  OWN, BOB, DX/NODX, TALK, WX and announcement/weather geography are absent.

Nearby filtering:
  NEARBY belongs to the GO expression bank; CC adds no proximity gate.

Preferences and propagation:
  SHOW SETTINGS          Show preferences and session settings.
  SET GRID               Set your Maidenhead grid square.
  SET NOISE              Set your receiving noise environment.
  SHOW PROP              Show an outlook to a callsign, prefix or grid.
  SET PATHSAMPLES        Set the minimum recent report units for paths.
  SHOW DEDUPE            Show duplicate-spot suppression settings.
  SET DEDUPE             Choose FAST, MED or SLOW duplicate suppression.
  SET SOLAR              Set the cadence for active solar summaries.
  DIALECT                Show or switch between GO and CC command styles.

Examples:
  SET GRID FN31
  SET NOISE SUBURBAN
  SHOW PROP DL 20 CW
  SET DEDUPE FAST
  SET SOLAR 30           Receive active solar summaries every 30 minutes.
  SET SOLAR OFF          Stop solar summaries.

Saving and loading presets:
  SAVE PRESET <name>     Save the active bank and shared preferences.
  LIST PRESET            List names shared by your numeric SSIDs.
  LOAD PRESET <name>     Apply its tagged bank and announce the selection.
  DELETE PRESET <name>   Remove the named preset.

Pausing live spots:
  PAUSE                  Pause live spots for 30 seconds.
  PAUSE 60               Pause for 60 seconds (maximum 300).
  SHOW HOLD              Show the remaining pause and suppressed spots.
  RESUME                 Resume live spots immediately.
  Filter/settings readbacks pause live spots; missed spots are not replayed.

Diagnostics:
  SHOW BUILD             Show version/build information.
  SHOW OWN               Show login and baseline own-call identity.
  SET DIAG               Choose diagnostic spot comments.

More help:
  HELP FILTERS           Native CC rules and support boundaries.
  HELP SYMBOLS           Confidence and path symbols.
  HELP <command>         Detailed command help.

Other commands:
  HELP                   Show this overview.
  DIALECT                Inspect or switch independent GO/CC banks.
  BYE                    Disconnect (also QUIT or EXIT).

Syntax used in detailed help:
  <value> is required; [value] is optional. A|B means choose one.
